node.statement: The ambient maps s:U(1) x calX -> calX, s(c,X)=cX, b:calX x calX -> calX, b(X,Y)=X bold-dot Y, and q:calX -> calX, q(X)=X^dagger are smooth as real maps: s and b are continuous bilinear maps and q is continuous conjugate-linear by def-epsilon-cstar-algebra. Their restrictions to products involving the smooth embedded manifold calM_delta are smooth ambient-valued maps. Moreover the stipulated codomains of alpha_C1, mu_C1, sigma_C1 and the membership antecedent ensure respectively that s(c,U) is in calU and that b(U,V),q(U) are in S_delta.
